candidate_and_evidence_lineage.envelope_b: QUALIFICATION-PREP-625, CANDIDATE-CI-627, GENERIC-QUALIFICATION-630, and HANDOFF-700 write receipts only in a separate external evidence-only worktree and append-only branch.
candidate_and_evidence_lineage.identity_rule: Envelope B commits never become, dirty, amend, merge into, or reidentify the candidate under test.
candidate_and_evidence_lineage.parent_binding: Every Envelope B record names the unchanged candidate commit and tree as subject plus its own predecessor evidence commit.
candidate_and_evidence_lineage.rollback: Supersede evidence append-only; invalidate candidate qualification on candidate or host drift and create a new freeze lineage.
